description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a national fast-food chain specializing in Louisiana-style fried chicken, operating out of a ground-floor unit at 700 Hamilton Street in downtown Vancouver. This location has no drive-through and offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a sit-down quick-service option in a dense urban area. For touring cyclists passing through the downtown core, it provides a convenient calorie stop with takeout available.
